facts.fact: ELPS typical gas molar composition percent: Methane 86, Ethane 6, Propane 3, iButane 0.8, nButane 1.2, C5+ 1.7, Nitrogen 0.7, CO2 4.2, H2S < 4 ppm. Derived Wobbe approx 49 MJ/m3; Methane Number approx 80.

assumptions.assumption: Gas USD 3.20/MMBtu Escravos city-gate plus 2.5% real per annum escalation.
assumptions.validation: Notebook 03 Gas contracting plus Notebook 07a sensitivity plus and minus 30% plus Notebook 07b Monte Carlo.

assumptions.assumption: Anchor tariff USD 110/kW-month Year 1 times 3% nominal times 15-yr take-or-pay. Sub-tenant fill 5 MW Year 6 at USD 130/kW-month.
assumptions.validation: Notebook 01 Market and Demand plus Notebook 07a tariff elasticity.

assumptions.assumption: Total capex approx USD 1,950/kW IT inclusive of 8% project contingency.
assumptions.validation: Notebook 05 Facility design plus Notebook 06 CAPEX line-by-line build-up.

assumptions.assumption: Capital stack: Senior 70% at 9% x 12-yr amort; Mezzanine 5% at 15%; Preferred 5% at 10%; Sponsor Common 20%. DSCR minimum covenant 1.25x; 1.40x mandatory cash sweep trigger.
Mechanical Completion Month 24; handover Month 25; ramp-up 80/90/100% in first three operating quarters.
